units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	As Gus ends his salute, the boy attacks him from behind, putting him into a choke hold. It's clear he's taking extreme care when doing it. "Did you wander out of the childcare district? Was it the spaceport landing area this time? I can see scratches and bruises all over you." Gus replies, "I'm sorry, Calvin! I was curious."|262|0

Was it the spaceport landing area this time? I can see scratches and bruises all over you." Gus replies, "I'm sorry, Calvin! I was curious."`

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	Calvin lets him out of the hold and says to you, "Thank you for saving my brother.
